comment: Generic evidence records. Import with: attest import examples/imports/evidence.json. Every record needs source, kind, control_ids, classification and payload{summary, result}; collected_at is optional (UTC, blank = now). Keys other than 'records' in this envelope are ignored; unknown keys inside a record are reported as warnings.
